title: Observability: the fleet in one place
purpose: Run a few jobs for different teams and show the fleet-wide view: where each job went, how much of each queue is used and borrowed.

steps.display: kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/mixed-llm: queue cpu, 2 pod(s) x cpu 1
